name: Runesmith
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Crafting or Performance, high choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion; high Int; moderate AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex; low to moderate HP; moderate to high accuracy; high damage; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Trace Rune, Invoke Rune, selection of runes appropriate for their level, Shield Block, runesmith feats appropriate for fighting style (Engraving Strike, Fortifying Knock, or Remote Detonation), Rune-Singer if Performance based

notes.skills: High Crafting or Performance (set: Crafting); high Arcana, Nature, Occultism or Religion, its choice.
notes.defense: Moderate AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex; low to moderate HP.
notes.offense: Moderate to high attack bonus and high damage.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC, standing in for its class DC: its runes work like spells, but it has no spellcasting.
notes.specials: Trace Rune, Invoke Rune, a selection of runes suited to its level, Shield Block; runesmith feats suited to its fighting style (Engraving Strike, Fortifying Knock or Remote Detonation); Rune-Singer if it uses Performance.
